disqualifier.note: Independent client-safe feature flags; docs and the view-model filter assign vs reopen on separate axes, and the example plus defaults set both true together. All 4 combinations are legal.

Independent SQL column intents. Combinators patch them separately (primaryKey/unique/version/default/serial/identity); the table projector applies .primaryKey() and .unique() on their own axes; isUniqueKey ORs uniqueness mechanisms. hasDefault is not a duplicate of default payload (serial/identity/autoIncrement set hasDefault without default). Combined-true is legal (example: defaultValue then version). Version rejects identity/generated, which are not sibling booleans.
